summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from a pinned GitHub release, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`, a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (rotating string-array obfuscator, single-line minified body). setup.mjs itself uses hex-named identifiers characteristic of an obfuscator.io transform. The advertised purpose of the package is a DTCG design-tokens library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated bundle through it. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on `npm install` before any consumer code opts in, and its behavior cannot be audited from the wrapper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
